headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth, with AI‑driven firms outpacing traditional players.
summary: Revenue grew across the sector, but the pace varied from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved for firms with strong AI contributions such as HCLTech and TCS. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech, reflecting uncertainty about macro demand. Overall sentiment remains positive but weighted by divergent performance.

themes.title: AI‑led growth
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue or AI‑driven deals posted the strongest top‑line and profit growth.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Infosys and Wipro showed modest revenue growth and lower margin expansion, prompting guidance cuts or flat profit.

themes.title: Mid‑tier expansion
themes.detail: LTM, Tech Mahindra and OFSS delivered solid double‑digit revenue growth without major AI disclosures.

leaders.why: Revenue up 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.
AI revenue of $219 m drove 21% profit growth and strong margin.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to ~1% YoY and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% but profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.
